description: Alembic migration script for adding report schedule related tables and constraints in a database schema for the Superset project.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Creates tables for report schedules, execution logs, recipients, and user associations, and sets up constraints and indexes.

methods.name: has_unique_constraint
methods.description: Checks if a specific unique constraint exists on a given table.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Drops the created tables, constraints, and indexes to revert the schema changes.
